claims.claim: The National Careers Service offers free careers advice.
claims.quote: The National Careers Service provides high quality, free and impartial careers advice, information and guidance.
claims.note: The text states the service provides free careers advice.

claims.claim: The service offers a skills assessment.
claims.quote: Take a skills assessment Answer questions about your interests and see some careers that might suit you.
claims.note: The service home page offers a skills assessment.

claims.claim: The service lets you browse job profiles.
claims.quote: Browse hundreds of job profiles to discover what different roles involve.
claims.note: The service home page offers job profile browsing.

claims.claim: The National Careers Service is a government service.
claims.quote: Search for courses and training online and get advice on qualifications and funding from: the National Careers Service (England)
claims.note: GOV.UK names the National Careers Service as the England service.

claims.claim: Adviser-led careers guidance for adults in England is given by DWP careers advisers through the Jobs and Careers Service.
claims.quote: If you’re aged 18 or older and live in England, you can contact a careers adviser through the DWP Jobs and Careers Service .
claims.note: The text says adults in England contact a careers adviser through the DWP Jobs and Careers Service.

claims.claim: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have their own careers services.
claims.quote: My World of Work (Scotland) Careers Wales Careers Service Northern Ireland
claims.note: The text lists separate careers services for Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
